docx_source: the canonical quality-sweep KEEP_DOCX trees (Linux container); Word on Windows
after: wp21 (Word lanes on the m2 trees; LibreOffice raw on m3)

parity_blank_page.what: even/odd headers + a page-number restart at the previous page's parity: Word inserts a blank page

legacy_cjk_font_name.what: BaseFont in Shift-JIS; face unknown -> FixedPitch -> Courier New in every slot

cjk_face_and_punctuation.what: Word lays CJK text wider than LibreOffice (missing DFKai-SB; uncompressed punctuation)

table_edge_hang.what: first-cell tcMar vs zero tblCellMar: Word hangs the row by the cell margin, LO by the table default

overflow_cascade.what: a page's content sets taller in Word than in LO and spills; causes seen: wrap at a superscript footnote reference (y18), table rows in narrow columns (y03), 3-column pages (y13, y61)

non_stock_fonts.what: Google-native families named by the standard profile; Word substitutes on a stock machine

table_indent_probe.note: [text_x, left_edge_x] pt; tblInd 50pt, margin 90pt; A per-cell tcMar 50, B tblCellMar 50, C paragraph indent 50, D tblCellMar 20 + tcMar 50, E tcMar 50 no indent (Windows LO 24.x triage)
